context: Hiroshi-boss outlines a business direction to Yuki.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; direction vocabulary (方針/現場/開始/終了/コスト/競争) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の方針を、共有しておこう。
lines.en: Let me share this term's policy.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 現場の意見も、反映されますか?
lines.en: Will the field's opinions be reflected?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろん、現場の声を方針に活かす。
lines.en: Of course, we'll use the field's voice in policy.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新計画は、いつ開始しますか?
lines.en: When does the new plan start?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月から開始し、年度末に終了する。
lines.en: It starts next month and ends at fiscal year-end.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: コストは、抑えられそうですか?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競争に勝つには、コストの管理が要だ。
lines.en: To win the competition, cost control is key.
lines.style: serious boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 方針に沿って、現場と進めます。
lines.en: I'll proceed with the field along the policy.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
